info.name: Opensidian
info.summary: Linked markdown note-taking with wikilinks, graph view and AI chat
info.description: Opensidian turns any Nextcloud folder of Markdown files into a linked knowledge base. Features: - Full-featured CodeMirror 6 markdown editor with split-pane live preview - [[Wikilink]] syntax with shortest-path resolution and backlinks panel - Force-directed D3 knowledge graph (Ctrl+G) with emoji color coding - AI chat panel — OpenAI-compatible, uses active note + linked notes as context - Hierarchical file tree with drag-and-drop, rename, delete and templates - Light / dark theme, adjustable font size, auto-save
info.author: Markus Begerow
